description: This file defines a React component called RoleCard, used within an explore UI context for showcasing job roles. It handles display of role details, user interaction for expanding/collapsing, integrating persona skills, setting roles as target roles, and visual effects.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a trimmed string, defaulting to empty string if null or undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Safely converts an unknown value to an array of strings, filtering out non-string values and nullish entries.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Converts an array of strings into cleaned, punctuated sentences suitable for display, ensuring each ends with proper punctuation.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Converts a value to a number constrained between 0 and 100, useful for percentage scores.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID as string from various possible role object structures.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts a unique list of skills from a persona object by checking multiple nested properties.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Converts a skill string to lowercase trimmed version for normalization.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds the intersection of persona skills and required skills, returning matched skills.
